content.body: MemTrace uses an Email + Password authentication path. Security measures include: bcrypt hashing (cost ≥ 12), password policy (8–128 characters, uppercase/lowercase + numbers, HaveIBeenPwned breach checks), email verification email (24-hour validity), and lockout for 15 minutes after 5 failures. After logging in, a JWT session is issued (7 days), transmitted via the Authorization: Bearer header, and invalidated immediately upon logout via a blocklist. Third-party OAuth login is currently not supported to simplify the authentication surface and minimize external dependencies.
